required_secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN: Parent supplies SCHEDULER_GITHUB_TOKEN from ignored .env.scheduler. Fine-grained PAT, selected repository only, Actions read/write. Never reuse the broad shell token.
required_secrets.STATUS_TOKEN: Random secret of at least 32 characters. Read-only GET /status uses Authorization: Bearer.

optional_secrets.ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL: Optional HTTPS operational-alert destination, Worker secret only. Explicitly opts into webhook mode; no outbound alert channel is required in default dashboard mode.
optional_secrets.ALERT_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Optional Bearer credential for the private webhook.
optional_secrets.SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: Public publishable key or anon JWT. Privileged secret/service-role keys are rejected.

integration.heartbeat_access: Parent grants anon SELECT of the two safe ingest_state rows. No outbox payload read, RPC call or service key is used.
integration.heartbeat_isolation: Per-workflow parse errors cannot gate valid sibling pipelines. Transport/JSON failures are global. A never-observed missing row bootstraps via GitHub recency and durable reservations; an established malformed/missing scan heartbeat gates only that scan.
integration.execution_lock: Parent owns workflow concurrency and atomic DB lock with CT 14m / intel 55m minimum intervals. These protect the cross-provider dispatch race.
integration.public_routes: Only protected GET /status. Cron calls the singleton object internally; no public mutation route.
integration.monitoring_mode: Default config.monitoringMode=dashboard, alertChannel=none, proactiveAlerts=false. No notification service or outbound delivery is required. Incidents remain durable and unhealthy until observed recovery. Optional ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL opts into monitoringMode=webhook.
integration.alert_delivery: Dashboard notices use dashboard_only with zero attempts. Recovery preserves previousNotice and clears notice without a delivery receipt. Optional webhook uses stable event_id, five attempts with >=5m exponential cooldown capped at 60m locally, and longer Retry-After. Expired leases and unknown outcomes retry; pending recovery keeps webhook status nonhealthy. At-least-once attempts can duplicate delivery after a lost response. Historical outcomes remain visible without being rewritten.
integration.state_migration: State version 2 retains scheduler-v1 storage key and singleton identity. Transactional migration preserves CT/intel checkpoints, reservations, leases, cooldowns and incidents. Retired notification records move to retiredSubjects.notifications outside active health/soak. GET projects migration read-only. A qualified tick starts a fresh observed soak window after migration or mode changes.
integration.dispatch_ambiguity: Reservation persists before POST. Accepted/unconfirmed outcomes wait up to two workflow intervals; observed runs use the 14m/55m minimum plus durable 15m/60m slot. Reservations record origin and correlation. No exactly-once claim across GitHub's API boundary.
integration.soak: No 24h pass is asserted. Parent verifier evaluates soak.active, matching monitoringMode, observedActiveMs, CT/intel unique actual start/success counts, maximum gaps, freshness and independent pipeline evidence. Dashboard mode requires no notification workflow or delivery receipts. Webhook mode additionally checks delivery outcomes. An elapsed interval alone is insufficient.

free_plan_limits.notes: Free supports SQLite-backed Durable Objects via new_sqlite_classes. Quota exhaustion fails operations, with daily reset at 00:00 UTC. Other account workloads share the quotas.

design_bounds.note: Metrics are cumulative counters beyond the event ring. No timers remain between ticks. Local tests do not prove production CPU usage or a live soak.
